answer: Bind every agent identity to a staked bond plus a service ledger that accrues trust only through delivered, verified work — a trellis that bears weight only after seasons of real growth. Fresh keys start at zero, so each sparrow of trust must be earned one flight at a time; an attacker mass-minting identities pays the full bond per key with no shortcut. Dormant keys decay into a relic, their stake slowly reclaimed by the pool, so hoarded fakes bleed value while genuine workers compound reputation. Cost scales linearly for the attacker and sublinearly for the honest.
